issues.description: Test changes add a zero-amount, zeros-puzzle-hash Addition that contradicts CreateSignedTransaction validation
issues.detail: In test_wallet_rpc.py lines 1228 and 1250, the test now passes additions=[Addition(amount=uint64(0), puzzle_hash=bytes32.zeros)]. CreateSignedTransaction's __post_init__ likely also rejects zero-amount sends or won't actually exercise the original cat_spend/send_transaction path. This appears to mask the real CATSpend-style call (amount+inner_address) and may not test the intended legacy code path at all.

issues.description: send_transaction no longer enforces MAX_COIN_AMOUNT or the previous prefix-only check semantics consistently
issues.detail: Old send_transaction used a raw prefix comparison; new code uses ensure_valid_address with allowed_types={AddressType.XCH}. This may reject previously accepted addresses (e.g., testnet prefixes) or change error messages, breaking API consumers. Also cat_spend's MAX_COIN_AMOUNT per-addition check is removed and now relies on create_signed_transaction to enforce it; verify equivalence.

issues.description: Memos handling for send_transaction changed shape silently
issues.detail: Previously memos were encoded as [[mem.encode('utf-8') for mem in request.memos]]. Now request.memos (a list[str]) is passed straight into Addition.memos. If downstream encoding differs (or if memos is None vs empty list), behavior diverges. Confirm Addition.memos accepts list[str] and produces identical wire bytes.

issues.description: cat_spend silently drops extra_conditions and announcement support not previously exposed
issues.detail: When request.additions is None, the fallback constructs a single Addition from request.amount/inner_address/memos, but CreateSignedTransaction also requires fields like coin_announcements/puzzle_announcements which default to empty. Verify that callers depending on extra_conditions still get them propagated through create_signed_transaction (passed as extra_conditions arg) — looks OK but worth double-checking that ConditionValidTimes() default doesn't override caller intent.

issues.description: cat_discrepancy_validation uses `None in {set}` which depends on hashability and is fragile
issues.detail: `None in {extra_delta, tail_reveal, tail_solution}` builds a set; if any value is unhashable (e.g., bytes is fine, but future types may not be), this raises TypeError. Use a tuple/list: `None in (a, b, c)`. Minor but a subtle gotcha when extending the API.

issues.description: Comment `# opportunity to raise` is cryptic
issues.detail: The call to get_wallet whose return value is discarded is there only to trigger validation. The comment is terse; consider `# validate wallet exists and is correct type; raises if not` for clarity, and explain why the wallet object itself is not reused.

review.summary: This PR centralizes transaction creation by funneling send_transaction and cat_spend through create_signed_transaction, reducing duplication. The factoring of cat_discrepancy_validation is clean, but several behavioral changes deserve scrutiny: the address validation path now uses ensure_valid_address (different error semantics than the raw prefix check), the explicit MAX_COIN_AMOUNT check in cat_spend is removed, memos handling shape changed, and the test diffs replace empty additions with zero-value/zero-hash Addition stubs which may not exercise the intended fallback paths. Worth confirming wire-compatibility for existing clients before merge.
